sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 43144 of 2023

Applicant :- Gautam Chauhan
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Sudhir Mehrotra,Virendra Kumar Mishra

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.462 of 2020 under sections 313, 120-B, 304,
506 and 376 IPC, Police Station Mugalsarai, District Chandauli.
3. This is second bail application, the first bail application was dismissed by this Court vide order dated 26.07.2021 with direction to conclude the trial within a period of two years.

4. The contention of the counsel for the applicant is that despite directions given by this court in the order dated 26.07.2021, there is no likelihood of the trial being concluded in the near future.

He argues that the case was committed before the Sessions Court on 08.09.2022 and thereafter none of Gautam Chauhan vs State Of U.P. on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106659938/
1 the prosecution witnesses, except PW-1, is coming forward as is clear from the order - sheet.

entities.text: Gautam Chauhan vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He argues that even the cross examination of PW-1 has not been concluded so far while total twenty two witnesses have to be examined.
The applicant is in custody since 17.12.2020 and has no criminal antecedents.

5. Considering the inordinate delay in initiating the trial despite an order passed by this court and the fact that the applicant has spent three years in custody coupled with the fact that there being no likelihood of the trial being concluded in the near future and the applicant has no criminal history,
the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Gautam Chauhan be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.25000/- (Twenty Five Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 18.12.2023 VNP/-
